spm 0.3.6+b0449d4f47c552b15e8d983a6c324318b864dbc0
spm (Skill and Plugin Manager) — a CLI, interactive REPL, and MCP server that installs AI agent skills from Git catalogs into Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, Google Antigravity, Cursor, Cline, Devin, Aider, GitHub Copilot, Hermes, OpenClaw, opencode, Sourcegraph Amp, and Pi. Find a skill by intent with ranked search, deploy it across every detected agent at once, or run spm as an MCP server so an agent can search and install skills itself.
Commands
Command             Description                                              
catalog ...         List configured skill catalogs and their sync status     
info <skillName>    Show details about a skill: catalog, description, install
                    status, references                                       
install <skillName> Deploy a skill to every detected AI agent — from your    
                    catalogs or straight from a GitHub repo (org/repo)       
list                List skills across synced catalogs (optionally filter by 
                    catalog, or --installed)                                 
resurrect           Review skills whose deployed files went missing; restore 
                    or forget them                                           
search <query>      Find skills by intent — ranked search across your        
                    catalogs' names and descriptions                         
uninstall           Remove a skill's files and rule sections from the agents 
                    it was deployed to                                       
update              Fetch a skill's latest version and refresh its           
                    deployments if it changed                                
version             Show the spm version                                     

Global Options
Name                    Description                                          
--help                  Show help for current scope or command.              
--interactive           Force interactive mode.
[truncated]
